Is 2026 Josh Allen’s Peyton Manning moment? 👀🏆

Peyton Manning didn’t win his first Super Bowl until his 9th NFL season, in 2006. By then, his biggest nemesis, Tom Brady, already had three Super Bowl rings.

Now look at Josh Allen.

2026 is Allen’s 9th NFL season. And just like Manning back then, his biggest rival, Patrick Mahomes, already has three Super Bowl rings.

The parallels are hard to ignore.

Manning finally broke through in Year 9 after seasons of coming up short against Brady. Now, Allen enters Year 9 still chasing that first Lombardi Trophy while Mahomes already has three.

Is this finally the year of Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills? 🔵🔴

“Today, the NFL concluded its review, and I accept its decision in full. To my family, to the players, coaches, and employees of the San Francisco 49ers, to our fans and partners, I am deeply sorry. This was an inexcusable mistake and I take full responsibility. What I did does not reflect my values or the man I strive to be for my family.
